query.rawSql: SELECT exporterAddr AS __value, if(argMax(exporterName, receivedAt) != '', argMax(exporterName, receivedAt), exporterAddr) AS __text FROM ${database}.flows GROUP BY exporterAddr ORDER BY __text

panels.title: Sources over the scan threshold

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Sources" FROM (
  SELECT srcAddr FROM ${database}.flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol IN (6, 17)
  GROUP BY srcAddr HAVING uniqExact(dstPort) >= $min_ports)

panels.description: Distinct source addresses touching at least the configured number of destination ports in the range. A count, not a verdict — backup agents and scanners look alike from flow data alone.

panels.title: SYN-only share of TCP flows

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 2) != 0 AND bitAnd(tcpFlags, 16) = 0)
       / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "SYN-only"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol = 6

panels.description: Percentage of TCP flows that carried a SYN without an ACK — connection attempts that never completed. A few percent is normal background; a sustained jump is either a scan or a service that stopped answering.

panels.title: Multicast and broadcast share

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * sumIf(bytes,
         dstAddr BETWEEN toIPv6('::ffff:224.0.0.0') AND toIPv6('::ffff:239.255.255.255')
         OR dstAddr = toIPv6('::ffff:255.255.255.255')
         OR (dstAddr >= toIPv6('ff00::') AND dstAddr <= toIPv6('ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff'))
       ) / nullIf(sum(bytes), 0), 2) AS "Multicast"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)

panels.description: Share of bytes destined for a multicast group or the IPv4 broadcast address. Derived from the destination address range — no separate counter needed. Worth watching when it climbs on a link that should carry unicast.

panels.title: Targets with unusual fan-in

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS "Targets" FROM (
  SELECT dstAddr FROM ${database}.flows
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)
  GROUP BY dstAddr HAVING uniqExact(srcAddr) >= $min_sources)

panels.description: Destination addresses contacted by at least the configured number of distinct sources. Normal for a public service; notable for anything else.

panels.title: SYN-only flow share over time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL $__interval_s SECOND) AS time,
       round(100 * countIf(bitAnd(tcpFlags, 2) != 0 AND bitAnd(tcpFlags, 16) = 0)
       / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "SYN-only %"
FROM ${database}.flows
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol = 6
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: The SYN-without-ACK ratio bucketed over the range. Counted over flows rather than the samples view, so one long session is one flow — the same population the stat above measures. Shape matters more than level: a step change is a state change on the network, a slow drift is usually a population change.

panels.title: Port scan candidates

value.title: Slice flows from this source (Flow Forensics)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source",
       uniqExact(dstPort) AS "Distinct ports",
       uniqExact(dstAddr) AS "Distinct targets",
       count() AS "Flows", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes",
       round(sum(bytes) / nullIf(count(), 0)) AS "Bytes per flow"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol IN (6, 17)
GROUP BY srcAddr HAVING "Distinct ports" >= $min_ports
ORDER BY "Distinct ports" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Sources ranked by how many distinct destination ports they touched. The bytes-per-flow column is the discriminator: scanning is many tiny flows, legitimate multi-port traffic carries data.

panels.title: Host sweep candidates

value.title: Slice flows from this source (Flow Forensics)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source",
       uniqExact(dstAddr) AS "Distinct targets",
       uniqExact(dstPort) AS "Distinct ports",
       count() AS "Flows", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol IN (6, 17)
GROUP BY srcAddr HAVING "Distinct targets" >= $min_targets
ORDER BY "Distinct targets" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Sources ranked by how many distinct destination addresses they touched. A sweep walks addresses on one port; a scan walks ports on one address — this panel and the one beside it separate the two.

panels.title: Repeated attempts against a service port

value.title: Slice flows from this source (Flow Forensics)
Slice flows to this service port (Flow Forensics)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source",
       replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Destination",
       dstPort AS "Port", count() AS "Attempts",
       round(sum(bytes) / nullIf(count(), 0)) AS "Bytes per flow"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter) AND protocol = 6
  AND dstPort IN (21, 22, 23, 25, 110, 143, 389, 445, 587, 993, 995,
                  1433, 3306, 3389, 5432, 5900, 6379, 27017)
GROUP BY srcAddr, dstAddr, dstPort HAVING "Attempts" >= $min_attempts
ORDER BY "Attempts" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Source, destination and port combinations with many small TCP flows — the shape of repeated authentication attempts. Restricted to well-known service ports so ordinary short-lived web traffic does not swamp the list.

panels.title: Fan-in targets

value.title: Slice flows to this target (Flow Forensics)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Target",
       uniqExact(srcAddr) AS "Distinct sources", count() AS "Flows",
       round(sum(bytes) * 8 / (toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime))) AS "Bits/s"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)
GROUP BY dstAddr HAVING "Distinct sources" >= $min_sources
ORDER BY "Distinct sources" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Destinations receiving traffic from an unusual number of distinct sources, with the rate they were receiving it at. Volumetric floods show up here as high source count and high rate together; a popular service shows high count alone.

panels.title: Packet-size outliers

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Source",
       replaceOne(toString(dstAddr), '::ffff:', '') AS "Destination",
       protocol AS "Protocol",
       round(sum(bytes) / nullIf(sum(packets), 0)) AS "Avg packet size",
       sum(packets) AS "Packets", sum(bytes) AS "Bytes"
FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(exporterAddr IN (${exporter:singlequote}), $exporter)
GROUP BY srcAddr, dstAddr, protocol
HAVING sum(packets) >= 100 AND ("Avg packet size" < 100 OR "Avg packet size" > 1500)
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Conversations whose average packet is far from normal — under 100 bytes (probe or keepalive traffic) or over 1500 (jumbo frames, or an exporter reporting nonsense). Only conversations with enough packets to be meaningful are listed.

description: What looks unusual in the traffic shape alone? Every panel is behavioural — counting fan-out, fan-in, flow size and TCP flags — so none of it needs a threat feed and none of it is an accusation. Thresholds are variables at the top: tune them to your network before treating any row as a finding. Scope with Tenant/Zone/Exporter, then pivot into Flow Forensics for a specific address.
